blocks.content: Consolidated chapter reviews significantly enhance memory retention for high-stakes exams.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Consolidated chapter reviews significantly enhance memory retention for high-stakes exams.
Targeted revision of core concepts helps eliminate common options-based errors in MCQs.
Regular self-assessment using key summary points ensures complete syllabus coverage.
Focus on high-yield summary points and recurring exam patterns during final review.
Ensure all key terms, definitions, and dates are memorized prior to attempting practice papers.
